title: HEAR PROTESTS against the proposed improvement and maintenance of the Rhodes Avenue and Tiara Street Lighting District, in accordance with Sections…
text:
[Council File 26-0900-S12; CD 2]
[Items Noticed for Public Hearing]
HEAR PROTESTS against the proposed improvement and maintenance of the Rhodes Avenue and Tiara Street Lighting District, in accordance with Sections 6.95-6.127 of the Los Angeles Administrative Code and Proposition 218.​
(Pursuant to Council adoption of Ordinance of Intention on September 22, 2026. The tabulation of ballots shall take place in Space 300 of 555 Ramirez Street on December 2, 2026 at 10 a.m. and will be publicly live-streamed. To access the live stream, join Zoom Meeting ID: 165 416 7710, Passcode: prop218. Public announcement of the tabulation of ballots and consideration of the Final Ordinance will take place at Council on January 12, 2027.)
summary: Council holds the required protest hearing on a proposed Rhodes Avenue and Tiara Street street lighting district in Council District 2, which would pay for the district's improvement and upkeep under Proposition 218. Ballots are counted December 2, 2026, and the final ordinance is set for January 12, 2027.
